    if num_communist_countries < 4:

import jinja2

def template_string(template_str, context):
    loader = jinja2.DictLoader({template_str: template_str})

    environment = jinja2.Environment(loader=loader)
    environment.globals['obj'] = jinja2.meta.find_referenced_templates(template_str)

    template = environment.get_template(template_str)

    return template.render(context)
